Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, David Strah, Joyce Hunter, and Jim Levin, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2. Updates regarding the National March on Washington for Lesbian and Gay Rights 3. Discussion of a new biography of Leonard Bernstein that outs him and multiple others in his circle, and the status of closeted celebrities COMMERCIAL: GCN Fundraiser 4. Ronald Reagan and George Bush booed after speaking in favor of mandatory AIDS testing, also necessity of having medical professionals discuss the issues, and not politicians COMMERCIAL: Human Rights Campaign Fund 5. Andy Humm on Mario Cuomo and Ed Koch "getting tough" on AIDS and the issue of mandatory testing 6. Clips from President Reagan and Vice-President George Bush's speeches on mandatory testing, booing of audience, and clips from the June 1st 1987 protest in front of the White House 7. News Watch, French researchers discover second, genetically different strain of HIV which also causes AIDS 8. "The San Francisco Chronicle" apologizes for omitting the names of surviving homosexual partners in obituaries 9. In a national poll, AIDS is found to be the third greatest fear of youths aged 8-17, behind only kidnapping and nuclear war, with 65% saying they are "very concerned" with AIDS, and other statistics 10. Liberace's estate sues Riverside County, CA as the coroner's linking the star's death with AIDS damaged his posthumous reputation COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 11. Sports Report COMMERCIAL: Lesbian and Gay Community Services Center 12. Lavender Health, interview with Rona Affoumado, clinic coordinator of the Community Health Project 13. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Naming Names, criticism of The New York Times, Sunday Magazine COMMERCIAL: Heritage of Pride, 24-hour Dance Marathon 2. Show Bits with George Trahanis, interview with David Drake of "Vampire Lesbians of Sodom" COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. Rebroadcast of Episode 6 of GCN's soap opera, "Suds": "Jock's Itch" 4. Closing credits
